videos.title: HOW TO GO TO THE 2 DIMENSIONS IN THE BLUE SKIES MOD IN MINECRAFT!

entry: TWO separate dimensions, each with its OWN portal, built like a Nether portal frame but from the dimension's own stone brick, and lit with blue_skies:zeal_lighter (the guide says 'zeoliter' - Whisper mangling of Zeal Lighter). Source 5NkFASCTTVs.
EVERDAWN: frame of blue_skies:lunar_stonebrick, lit with blue_skies:zeal_lighter, creating blue_skies:everdawn_portal. The guide describes arriving to 'purple trees, purple everything'.
EVERBRIGHT: frame of blue_skies:turquoise_stonebrick, lit with blue_skies:zeal_lighter, creating blue_skies:everbright_portal. The guide notes you 'end up in a cave' and have to climb to the surface.
The guide says the frame is 'similar to a nether portal... just make it kinda skinnier', so exact dimensions are NOT reliably captured here.
Both stone bricks and the lighter must be obtained in the OVERWORLD before either dimension is reachable - this is the fact the generator most needs.
boss_order: NOT CAPTURED. Only the entry video was transcribed for this mod. Blue Skies' dungeon/boss ladder (each dimension has its own) is NOT sourced here and must not be invented.
order: You spawn holding a lore book the guide calls 'Blue Lore', but in the version filmed it was unopenable: 'this item is a work in progress and incomplete so you can't open the book yet'. Do NOT build a quest around reading it without checking it works in 1.20.1.
Everbright drops you underground; the first task on arrival there is to dig up to the surface.
gates: HARD GATE: no portal lights without blue_skies:zeal_lighter. Flint and steel does not work.
traps: The guide warns the Immersive Portals mod is incompatible (loader/mixin mismatch in the version filmed). Version-specific, but worth not promising portal-linking behaviour.
signature: blue_skies:zeal_lighter - the single item that unlocks both dimensions.
blue_skies:lunar_stonebrick and blue_skies:turquoise_stonebrick - the two frame materials that distinguish Everdawn from Everbright.
